Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

R3DFEM 0.2.0

The package now runs only the version 5.7 of the 3D-CMCC-FEM.

Breaking changes

  • run_3DCMCCFEM() runs the version 5.7 (it has the arguments of the former run_3DCMCCFEM_5.7()); the version 5.6 is no longer supported. Use R3DFEM 0.1.0 for the 5.6.
  • The model executable is no longer shipped with the package: install it once with install_model() (download, or copy of a local file) or set options(R3DFEM.exe = ...) / the environment variable R3DFEM_EXE. This also allows binaries compiled on Linux or macOS.
  • make_meteo_EOBS() handles the E-OBS versions 30.0 (default) and 29.0 (version), reads the netCDF files from eobs_dir (option R3DFEM.eobs_dir) and names the files of several points id_meteo.txt (site_id_meteo.txt with site), as make_soil_ISRIC().
  • make_soil_ISRIC() reads the SoilGrids raster from isric_file (option R3DFEM.isric_file).
  • check_inputs() has no version argument: the species files must always contain the parameters of the 5.7 (e.g. CONV_VOL_FACTOR).
  • The gif functions (make_gif_3DFEM() and the internal gif helpers) were removed, together with the dependencies rgl, rLiDAR (archived on CRAN), FNN, magick, gifski, gt, RColorBrewer and doParallel.
  • The run messages are sent with message() (they can be silenced with suppressMessages()).

New functions

  • install_model(), model_path(), model_available().
  • list_species(), species_file(), copy_species(): parameterizations of the version 5.7 for 19 European species (including coppice), in extdata/species.
  • setup_inputs() prepares the whole input directory of a site in one call.
  • read_output() reads daily, monthly and annual outputs (one or many files) as a data.frame, with a DATE column.
  • run_batch() runs many simulations (sites, scenarios, options, species parameters), each in its own directory, sequentially or in parallel with future.
  • param_sensitivity() (now exported) is based on run_batch() and returns the data and a ggplot.

Deprecated

  • run_3DCMCCFEM_5.7() and make_meteo_EOBS_30.0() are aliases of run_3DCMCCFEM() and make_meteo_EOBS().

Other changes

  • Example data: the BilyKriz, Hyytiala and Soroe inputs use the 5.7 parameterizations; the 5.6 executables and outputs were removed.
  • The species files are read also when saved with a byte order mark.
  • make_co2() accepts a data.frame with a single year.
  • plot_output_3DFEM() and virtual_stand_generator() use read_output(); plot_output_3DFEM() no longer warns when plotting integer and double variables together.
  • run_3DCMCCFEM() warns when outputdir is too long for the model (260 characters limit of the paths).
  • Unit tests (testthat), GitHub Actions (R CMD check, pkgdown site), a precomputed “Getting started” vignette and a new vignette on the input files.

R3DFEM 0.1.0

New functions

  • make_stand(), make_co2(), make_management(), make_soil() and make_meteo() create the input files from user data.
  • read_species() and set_species_param() read and modify species parameterization files, keeping comments.
  • check_inputs() runs the consistency checks of the run functions without running the model.
  • New vignette vignette("R3DFEM"), running the model version 5.7.
  • run_3DCMCCFEM_5.7() and check_inputs(version = "5.7") check that the species files contain CONV_VOL_FACTOR, required by the 5.7 executable.
  • New example file extdata/species_5.7/Piceaabies.txt (5.7 parameterization of Norway spruce); the 5.7 executable is now in extdata/Debug, where run_3DCMCCFEM_5.7() looks for it.

Bug fixes

  • run_3DCMCCFEM() and run_3DCMCCFEM_5.7():
    • with co2 = "off" or "var" the model used the settings file of co2 = "on" (silently, if one existed from a previous run);
    • stands with more classes or species and man = "on" failed;
    • replanting of more species (rep_species vector) failed in the checks;
    • man = "var", pres_dens = "on", after_pres = "off", reg = "on" failed (“object ‘mn’ not found”);
    • the working directory of the user was changed and not restored;
    • outputdir was not created when its parent directory did not exist;
    • the 5.7 version ignored reg_species with a single replanted species;
    • a clear error with the model log is given when the model produces no output. They now return invisibly the paths of the output files.
  • make_meteo_EOBS_30.0() without id wrote the meteo variables in the wrong columns; make_meteo_EOBS() (v29) failed because the wind speed file is not available (wind speed was not used).
  • make_soil_ISRIC() weighted the soil layers dividing by their thickness instead of multiplying; a data.frame of coordinates was not accepted.
  • check_meteo_3DFEM(): anomalous values were reported only when all rows were wrong, the check on the number of months used the days, error messages had wrong thresholds; it now returns a data.frame and save defaults to FALSE as documented.
  • make_CCS(): failed with a single leap year in obs_year and with data.table/tibble inputs; years after obs_year[2] were duplicated; the global random seed was changed.
  • plot_output_3DFEM() did not work (data.table syntax), nor with window or x, and saved files outside outdir.
  • plot_soil_3DFEM() did not read soil files with // comments; save_plot defaults to FALSE as documented.
  • make_topo(), virtual_stand_generator() and make_gif_3DFEM() fixes.

Removed

  • make_stand_INFC() and the INFC data (specie, tree_level_species).
